items.detail: Install BEFORE you fly — it cannot be downloaded inside the firewall. Routes offshore, so WhatsApp, Gmail, Maps and Instagram just work without a VPN.
Install and test at home. The backup if the eSIM fails; provider sites are blocked from inside China.
Whatever SIM you use. Connecting kills WhatsApp until you switch back to cellular.
items.item: Hotel Wi-Fi is inside the firewall

items.detail: It sits inside the firewall, which kills WhatsApp — James's only real channel. The 2017 advice is now the wrong advice.
The main wallet. Verify against your passport by ~24 Sep; review takes one to three business days. Also runs metro fares and the airport ride code.
Second wallet, and how James's colleagues will reach you. Bind a card before you go.
Tibet: monastery offerings, photo fees, tips — draw it before you leave Lhasa. Also Xi'an street stalls: the smallest ones show a PERSONAL QR code, which declines a foreign card outright.
The map that actually works in China. Chinese-first interface but the routing is correct where Google's is not.
Offline vector maps, no account, no connection. Download Shaanxi, Tibet and Shanghai at home.
Taxis. Has an English mode. This is how you get from Hongqiao to the hotel at 22:30 on the 10th.
Trains and domestic flights with a foreign passport and card. 12306 is the official source but fights foreigners.
Offline Chinese dictionary with a camera OCR mode — point it at a menu or a sign.
Download Chinese for offline use BEFORE you fly. Camera mode handles signs; conversation mode handles taxi drivers.
Reviews and queue numbers for restaurants. Chinese only, but the star ratings translate.
Fill it in within 24 hours of landing rather than on paper in the queue at Xi'an.
Your park ticket, wait times and Premier Access. Register at home, expect to finish verification on a Chinese network.
